question_stem:
A uniform electric field is produced between two parallel metal plates. The electric field strength is
1.4 × 10^{4} N C^{-1}. The potential difference between the plates is 350 V.
question_stem_latex:
A uniform electric field is produced between two parallel metal plates. The electric field strength is
$1.4 \times 10^{4}\,\mathrm{N}\,\mathrm{C}^{-1}$. The potential difference between the plates is 350 V.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the separation of the plates.
separation = m
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the separation of the plates.
$separation = m $

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A nucleus of mass 8.3 × 10^{-27} kg is now placed in the electric field. The electric force acting
on the nucleus is 6.7 × 10^{-15} N.
parts.question_text_latex:
A nucleus of mass $8.3 \times 10^{-27}\,\mathrm{kg}$ is now placed in the electric field. The electric force acting
on the nucleus is $6.7 \times 10^{-15}\,\mathrm{N}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the charge on the nucleus in terms of e, where e is the elementary charge.
charge = e
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the charge on the nucleus in terms of e, where e is the elementary charge.
$charge = e $

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the mass, in u, of the nucleus.
mass = u

Calculate the mass, in u, of the nucleus.
$mass = u $
